title: Bazar saja hai aur zainab be chadar
body:
bazare shaam darbaare shaam-2
<<MINI>>
haye haye zainab haye haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
baazaar saja hai aur zainab be chadar
<<MINI>>
haye haye zainab haye haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
raaho me log sharabi aur binte ali faryaadi
ek chadar maang rahi hai ummat se syed zaadi aur log tamashaayi aaye hai bankar
har soo naapaak nigaahe aur aale nabi ki aahe'n
sang baari karne aaye sab log sajakar raahe'n
<<DIVIDER>>
is gham se haram hai seena zan nouhagar
hai kaisi qayaamat aayi taqdeer kaha'n par laayi
har zaqm saha hai dil par har chot jigar par khaayi
ye shaam ki galiyaa'n kehti hai ro ro kar
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki qwahar zainab haye binte hyder zainab
baalou se chupa kar chehra phirti hai dar dar zainab
haye kaisi qayamat ka logo ye manzar
jis ghar se parda daari ki rasm hui thi jaari
<<DIVIDER>>
beparda dekhne unko aayi hai dunya saari
zainab ke kaleje par chalte hai qanjar
ye zulm bhi kaisa dhaaya bazaare shaam sajaya
hathou se ishara kar ke bibi ka naam bataya
<<DIVIDER>>
girta tha waha beemar mera ghash kha kar
